Name: CHARACTER_INIT_PARAM
Description: Determines starting classes and starting gifts.

Fields.Name: MP recovery (seconds)
Fields.Description: The game has no MP pool, so this does nothing. Classes store 0.

Fields.Name: Stamina recovery (seconds)
Fields.Description: Time to recover 1 stamina. The game may ignore it. Classes store 0.

Fields.Name: Cushion When Landed On (%)
Fields.Description: May cut damage when another character lands on this one. Classes store 0.

Fields.Name: Starting souls
Fields.Description: The amount the character starts with.

Fields.Name: Right-hand weapon
Fields.Description: Weapon equipped in the right hand. None leaves the hand empty.

Fields.Name: Right-hand spare
Fields.Description: Second weapon in the right-hand slot. None leaves it empty.

Fields.Name: Left-hand weapon
Fields.Description: Shield or weapon equipped in the left hand. None leaves the hand empty.

Fields.Name: Left-hand spare
Fields.Description: Second shield or weapon in the left-hand slot. None leaves it empty.

Fields.Name: Helm
Fields.Description: Head armor the character starts wearing. None starts bareheaded.

Fields.Name: Armor
Fields.Description: Body armor the character starts wearing. None starts bare.

Fields.Name: Gauntlets
Fields.Description: Arm armor the character starts wearing. None starts barehanded.

Fields.Name: Leggings
Fields.Description: Leg armor the character starts wearing. None starts barefoot.

Fields.Name: Arrows
Fields.Description: Arrows the character starts with. None starts with none.

Fields.Name: Bolts
Fields.Description: Bolts the character starts with. None starts with none.

Fields.Name: Spare arrows
Fields.Description: Second arrow type the character starts with. None starts with none.

Fields.Name: Spare bolts
Fields.Description: Second bolt type the character starts with. None starts with none.

Fields.Name: Ring 1
Fields.Description: The ring the character wears in the first ring slot. The game has two ring slots.

Fields.Name: Ring 2
Fields.Description: The ring the character wears in the second ring slot. The game has two ring slots.

Fields.Name: Ring 3
Fields.Description: Unused. The game has two ring slots, and no starting class or gift uses this field.

Fields.Name: Ring 4
Fields.Description: Unused. The game has two ring slots, and no starting class or gift uses this field.

Fields.Name: Ring 5
Fields.Description: Unused. The game has two ring slots, and no starting class or gift uses this field.

Fields.Name: Skill 1

Fields.Name: Skill 2
Fields.Description: Unused. Classes store None.

Fields.Name: Face preset
Fields.Description: Face shape for rows the game draws as bodies. Classes store 0. Character creation decides the player's face.

Fields.Name: AI
Fields.Description: The NPC behavior this row uses. The game ignores it for the player.

Fields.Name: Health
Fields.Description: Maximum health. Classes store 0 and the game computes it from Vitality.

Fields.Name: Mana
Fields.Description: Maximum mana. The game has no mana pool, so this does nothing. Classes store 0.

Fields.Name: Stamina
Fields.Description: Maximum stamina. Classes store 0 and the game computes it from Endurance.

Fields.Name: Arrow count
Fields.Description: How many arrows the character starts with.

Fields.Name: Bolt count
Fields.Description: How many bolts the character starts with.

Fields.Name: Spare arrow count
Fields.Description: How many spare arrows the character starts with.

Fields.Name: Spare bolt count
Fields.Description: How many spare bolts the character starts with.

Fields.Name: World state 1
Fields.Description: Unknown. A Demon's Souls leftover, 0 on every row. Its effect here is not documented.
